message.content: YurikoYamamoto has enlisted Li Hua's assistance for several tasks related to improving and enhancing her studio's homepage. These tasks include addressing user feedback, designing a user feedback section, testing a new automatic scheduling feature, and brainstorming ideas for a blog section. Additionally, YurikoYamamoto has requested feedback on ten logo designs for her speech therapy studio, suggesting that Li Hua may also be involved in the redesign or selection process of these logos. Through these various projects, Li Hua is contributing to the visual and functional enhancement of YurikoYamamoto's online presence, aiming to improve customer experience and engagement.
